messages:
mike: Quick FYI — sample app edge build failing TS on our SDK overloads when input is `unknown` from JSON.parse
 tara: Error text?
 mike: "No overload matches this call..." at sdk.generate(parsed) where parsed: unknown. Works in node CJS, fails in edge ESM bundle.
 oliver: Likely overload resolution + different .d.ts ordering from our esbuild/rollup pipeline vs tsc. `moduleResolution: bundler` also affects this.
 mike: Locally switching tsconfig to `moduleResolution: 'node'` fixes it but can't ask all users to change.
 tara: Short-term fix: collapse to single generic: `generate<T = unknown>(opts: GenerateOptions<T>): Promise<...>` remove the separate `GenerateOptions<unknown>` overload. Fewer overloads -> fewer inference surprises.
 oliver: Agreed. Also add a note in sample-app README: workaround and link to SDK patch. File an issue to compare emitted declarations between edge and node builds.
 ci-bot: CI: edge-typecheck failed for branch mike/edge-typing (exit 1) — https://ci.internal/edge-typing/77
 mike: I'll open a small PR to consolidate types, add changelog and sample-app troubleshooting. ping me for review.
